user.title: xquirks
user.description:
Offers the quirk files of this collection that match your ZHA devices. It writes nothing on its own: every install, update and removal comes in one change list, a repair issue for you to confirm.

ZHA's custom quirks folder: `{folder}`

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only one entry is possible.

init.title: Devices xquirks leaves alone
init.description:
xquirks installs no quirk file just for these devices and removes the files only they use, with the next change list. A file that another device needs is installed or kept: ZHA applies it to every device it lists, these included (the change list names them).

Devices disabled in Home Assistant are left alone the same way.

missing_quirks_path.title: ZHA has no custom quirks folder
missing_quirks_path.description:
ZHA loads custom quirk files only from a folder named in configuration.yaml. Until there is one, this integration offers nothing.

1. Create the folder, for example `/config/custom_zha_quirks` (with the File editor, Samba or SSH app). It has to exist before the next step.
2. Add these lines to `configuration.yaml`:

```yaml
zha:
  custom_quirks_path: /config/custom_zha_quirks/
```

3. Restart Home Assistant.

folder_unreadable.title: The custom quirks folder cannot be read
folder_unreadable.description:
This integration cannot read ZHA's custom quirks folder `{folder}`: {error}

Until it can, the change list and the notices stay as they are and nothing is written. Check the folder's permissions.

no_content_state.title: xquirks has no quirk list yet
no_content_state.description:
xquirks loads the list of quirk files from the GitHub repository it comes from and has no list it can use yet: {reason}

It tries again every 15 minutes. **Check for quirk updates** on the xquirks device (Settings > Devices & services > xquirks) tries now.

changes.title: Quirk changes for your Zigbee devices: {count}

confirm.title: Quirk changes

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
abort.stale: The list changed while this dialog was open: nothing was changed. The new list is under Settings > System > Repairs.
abort.held_pending: Nothing was changed: a change waits for ZHA to load the custom quirks folder again (reload ZHA or wait for its next start).
abort.held_unchecked: Nothing was changed: a file of the list could not be downloaded and checked yet, xquirks tries again in a few minutes.
abort.held_zha_unknown: Nothing was changed: ZHA is not loaded, or xquirks cannot read which quirks it applies: the list waits for ZHA.
abort.held_no_content: Nothing was changed: xquirks has no quirk list it can use right now.
abort.held_no_folder: Nothing was changed: ZHA has no custom quirks folder.
abort.held_unreadable_folder: Nothing was changed: the custom quirks folder cannot be read.
abort.failed:
Nothing was changed: {failed}

xquirks put back what it had changed before this step. Try again once the cause is gone: the repair then lists what is still to do.
abort.done:
{done}

ZHA is reloading the custom quirks folder `{folder}` now: your Zigbee devices are back in a few seconds.
abort.done_zha_not_loaded:
{done}

ZHA is not loaded right now: it uses the changes in `{folder}` when it starts.
abort.not_now: Put aside: nothing changes. It waits under Settings > System > Repairs > three-dot menu > Show ignored repairs: open it there to decide later. A different list comes back as a new repair.

blocked.title: {quirk} runs on another custom quirk
blocked.description:
{picture}{devices}

This collection has `{file}` for it ({status}). xquirks does not write it while a custom quirk of yours handles the device: both files would claim it, then ZHA picks one by fingerprint and file name. To switch, remove your quirk file and reload ZHA; the change list brings the file then.

users_file.title: A file of yours has the name of the quirk for {quirk}
users_file.description:
{picture}`{file}` in `{folder}` has the name of a file of this collection, but this integration did not write it. It leaves your file alone, so it cannot install its own.

To use the file of this collection, delete yours and reload ZHA: the change list brings it then.

not_applied.title: ZHA does not use the quirk for {quirk}

misfit.title: The quirk for {quirk} does not fit your device

changed.title: Changed quirk left alone: {quirk}
changed.description:
{picture}`{file}` in `{folder}` was installed by this integration and changed since. It is left as it is: no change list updates or removes it.

To hand it back to this integration, undo your change or delete the file.

reload.title: Quirk changes wait for a ZHA reload: {count}

confirm.title: Reload ZHA

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
abort.nothing_to_do: Nothing to do any more: the files or devices changed in the meantime.
abort.not_now: Put aside: ZHA uses the changes when it next loads, at the latest after a restart of Home Assistant. It waits under Settings > System > Repairs > three-dot menu > Show ignored repairs: open it there to decide later.

withdrawn_copy.title: Withdrawn quirk copy for {quirk}
withdrawn_copy.description:
{picture}`{file}` in `{folder}` has no record in this integration (it was put there by hand, or its record was lost). It is revision {revision} of this collection, which was withdrawn: {reason}

ZHA loads it for your devices. Remove it from the folder and reload ZHA. Once your copy is gone, the change list brings the current file of this collection, if it ships one for this Home Assistant release.

withdrawn_installed.title: Withdrawn quirk revision in use: {quirk}
withdrawn_installed.description:
{picture}`{file}` in `{folder}` is revision {revision} of this collection, which was withdrawn: {reason}

ZHA uses it for your devices until the change list updates it to a revision that is not withdrawn or removes it: see Settings > System > Repairs (an ignored list is under Show ignored repairs).

download_waiting.title: Quirk changes wait for a download

unavailable.title: Quirk file cannot be downloaded: {quirk}
unavailable.description:
`{file}` of the content state in use cannot be used: {error}

No change list writes it. An installed copy of it stays at its revision while its devices use it and no other file takes one of them. Please report it in the xquirks issue tracker with the diagnostics of this integration (Settings > Devices & services > xquirks > three-dot menu > Download diagnostics).

refused.title: Quirk file refused: {quirk}
refused.description:
`{file}` (revision {revision}) holds code this integration does not allow in a quirk file or targets devices it is not offered for. This integration refused it: no change list writes it. An installed copy of it stays at its revision while its devices use it and no other file takes one of them; the change list says when it goes.

This should never happen. It can mean that someone tampered with the repository this integration loads its quirk files from. Please report it in the xquirks issue tracker with the diagnostics of this integration (Settings > Devices & services > xquirks > three-dot menu > Download diagnostics).
